title: CNFM Site Inventory
description: Comprehensive inventory management for the CNFM site, tracking deliveries and monitoring stock movement.
longDescription: Evolved from a signage count into a full-scale inventory system. It monitors the 'taking out' and delivery process for the entire CNFM site to ensure 100% accuracy in stock levels.

title: MediFort
description: Secure hospital IT infrastructure using pfSense and Active Directory.
longDescription: Because this is core infrastructure, the 'Live' view showcases the network topology and security configuration used to protect hospital data.
